2011-12 league rank 5; reigning Europa League titleholder
2011-12 Copa del Rey losing finalist (Barcelona UCL qualifier), league rank 10

knownBirthdateConflicts: Éric Abidal — FootballSquads 1979-07-11 vs Barcelona historical official 1979-09-11; provisionally retained 1979-09-11.
Adriano Correia — FootballSquads 1984-10-26 vs historical Barcelona 1984-10-20; provisionally retained 1984-10-26.
Pedro López — FootballSquads/Sky Sports 1983-01-01 vs Transfermarkt/Sofascore 1983-11-01; retained 1983-11-01 with independent agreement, conflict still logged.
Eduardo Salvio — FootballSquads/Sky Sports 1990-05-13 vs UEFA/BDFutbol/PremierLeague 1990-07-13; retained 1990-07-13, conflicting source explicitly logged.
notes: All 7 clubs have 11 tactical-slot nominees, capped backup candidates; actual squad-specific structures varied.
Some players with 20+ starts categorized as backup/starter-equivalent for tactical caps; backup does not imply weak individual role.
Málaga Cazorla CM/Isco CAM approximation requires game-by-game role validation.
Barcelona Fàbregas CAM classified as reserve tactical-role nominee even with 23 starts; variable 3-4-3/4-3-3 structure.
Athletic Javi Martínez treated as CB, De Marcos as CM; Bielsa's fluid positional usage needs game-by-game audit.
Atlético Simeone midseason arrival changes the 4-2-3-1 tactical inference.
High-scoring output alone does not establish qualitative 3-season rank; all grades are unapproved hypotheses.
La Liga 2011-12 starters as listed by BDFutbol are NOT a factual club-specific optimal starting XI, selection uses a tactical proxy.
2011-12 actual Arda left side and Adrián right side supported by contemporary Atlético lineups/National Football Teams, but per-game majority sample remains incomplete.
Corrected Levante Nano 1980-07-07 using Levante official, Pedro López 1983-11-01 vs conflicting FootballSquads/Sky, Atlético Salvio 1990-07-13 per UEFA/BDFutbol vs Sky/FootballSquads May entry.
